failure_summary.description: Follow-up filters were generated without saving their outputs under new cache keys.
A proposed attraction was treated as a no-op, and a newly stated budget was ignored in favor of reapplying an existing cuisine filter.
The agent imported tools from a nonexistent module despite the injected-tool runtime contract.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly prohibits imports, requires saving transformed results, and directs agents to apply only newly stated criteria to compatible cached results. These failures repeat violations of existing guidance rather than reveal a missing rule; similar elaborations were ineffective in prior steps, so no edit is warranted.
